_instructions: Fill in ONE object per project inside the 'projects' array.
Leave ALL images out — you'll upload them later in /studio (thumbnail, gallery images, videos, og image).
REQUIRED fields: type, title, subtitle, category, order.
type        -> 'web'  (websites / AI products / SEO / social / branding)  OR  'video' (video / reels).
category    -> one of: ai | web | photography | video | social | seo | branding   (drives the Work filter tabs).
order       -> a number; lower shows first.
results     -> array of { value, metric }; the FIRST one becomes the headline on the Work card.
Everything else is optional — delete any line you don't need.
When done, send me this file and I'll import every project into Sanity (images stay empty for you to add).
